subject: Atlas Retail — alignment on workshop timing & pre-reads
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@atlasretail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail — initial workshop slot

Hi Irene + team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we had a productive internal sync and want to lock the hands-on session. Two asks before we confirm: 1) can we move the session from Aug 18th to Aug 20th (we have a leadership all-hands on 18th), and 2) please send a single prep pack (agenda + quick checklist) oriented to our infra folks plus the prompt review list you mentioned.

High level we want the working session to cover: prompt engineering examples for retail search, routing fallback behaviors (latency-sensitive vs cost-sensitive), and one short load test (10-minute token burst) to validate concurrency assumptions.

Tentative attendees on our side: Amit Shah (SRE lead), infra-ops@atlasretail.com (shared mailbox), + two ML engineers (TBD).

Can you confirm: new date availability (Aug 20) and whether Redwood needs any network prep (VPN, IP allowlist) beforehand?

Thanks,
Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Platform Engineering
Atlas Retail
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@atlasretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail — alignment on workshop timing & pre-reads

Hi Amit — appreciate the heads-up. Aug 20 works for our team; I'm proposing a 90-minute hands-on window 09:30–11:00 PDT so we can do prompt review (30m), routing & failover discussion (20m), and a short orchestrated load test (30m) with a 10-minute steady burst plus 10m debrief.

I attached a compact prep pack (agenda + checklist) and a loadtest plan. Quick notes:
- Network: if you can add these IP ranges to allowlist (attached in the readpack), we'll avoid VPN fragility. Otherwise we'll use a shared SSH bastion approach.
- Prompts: please surface 3 production prompts you want tuned (we'll run a prompt walk-through and provide suggested tokenization/templating changes).
- Roles: request that an SRE and one ML engineer join the session; an additional product owner is helpful but optional.

Action items for Atlas (short):
1) Confirm Aug 20 09:30–11:00 PDT
2) Share the three prompts (paste into a shared doc or attach) by EOD Aug 17
3) Add allowlist entries or confirm bastion access by Aug 18

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm the date. Attaching: atlas-session-agenda-v1.pdf, redwood-prep-readpack.md, loadtest-window-plan.xlsx

Best,
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@atlasretail.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail — alignment on workshop timing & pre-reads

Looping in a short ops checklist for the load window — attaching the plan export. Quick logistics:
- We'll provision a dedicated test queue in the regional cluster for the 30m burst so it doesn't affect other customers.
- Target throughput for the burst: 600 concurrent tokens/s (we'll scale horizontally if we see queueing).
- Monitoring: we will stream latency and token-cost dashboards to your team Slack channel for the session.

Camila will run the prompt walk-through with your ML engineer. If Atlas needs an on-call phone or Slack bridge during the test, tell us which channel to post to.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@atlasretail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: infra-ops@atlasretail.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail — alignment on workshop timing & pre-reads

Thanks — Aug 20 confirmed 09:30–11:00 PDT. We've opened a short window with infra and will provide the three prompts by Aug 17 COB.

Two quick clarifications:
1) Allowlist — infra is OK to add the IPs you provided, but they'd prefer to do a brief firewall rules dry-run on Aug 18 (30 minutes). Can you make an ops-only availability slot that day?
2) Slack bridge — yes please. We'll create a channel #atlas-redwood-test and add your ops contact.

Appreciate the concise pack — reading through now, will revert if we need tweaks.

Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, Atlas Retail
